issue.title: "Too big timeout specified" in CppCassandraDriverTest.TestCreateIndexSlowTServer

repository.name: yugabyte-db
repository.description: YugabyteDB - the cloud native distributed SQL database for mission-critical applications.

issue.body:
Observed this with Clang 12 ASAN x86_64 build.
```c++
  if (controller->timeout().Initialized() && controller->timeout() > 3600s) {
    LOG(DFATAL) << "Too big timeout specified: " << controller->timeout();
  }
```
